sources.entry: PSIBar - Quickly hacked up PSI macOS status bar app.

summary.one_liner: PSIBar is a small macOS status bar app that shows Singapore's PSI/PM2.5 air quality reading, fetched from NEA data.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a quickly hacked-together macOS menu bar (status bar) app that displays PSI and PM2.5 air pollution readings. It requires an API key from NEA (Singapore's National Environment Agency), which is entered into the strings in the file PSIWeatherAPI.swift. The README gives no further detail on the display format, refresh behaviour, or other settings. The project is a personal experiment, and the README invites file issues for improvements but lists no roadmap items.
use_cases: check Singapore air quality from the macOS menu bar
monitor PSI or PM2.5 readings at a glance
personal macOS status bar weather widget
how_to_run: Register for an API key with NEA
Open PSIWeatherAPI.swift and enter the API key into the strings
Build and run the app in Xcode
notable: Shows PSI/PM2.5 air quality in the macOS status bar
Uses NEA (Singapore National Environment Agency) data via an API key
Simple, small codebase centred on one API file
caveats: Requires a personal NEA API key before it will fetch data
Described as a quickly hacked-up project with no stated maintenance or roadmap
README gives no build instructions beyond key setup; macOS only
